SCRIPT W-Br Richard, we haven't received the shipment of roses yet. M-Au Oh no! We need them for the floral arrangements that we're supposed to create for the Korkle Hotel. W-Br I know. We'll have to come up with an alternative solution. M-Au Right. l'll find another source for the flowers. Can you start the arrangements with what we have? W-Br Yes, of course. But, l will need to leave early today to go to the doctor. Maria will cover the end of my shift.

SCRIPT M-Cn Hello. This is James Davis. I'm calling about my appointment with Dr. Kapoor. W-Am Right. l have you down for a regular checkup at ten thirty. M-Cn Well, it looks like I'm going to be about twenty minutes late. I'm stuck in some slow traffic on the Highland Bridge. W-Am OK. I'll let the doctor know. And remember, we've moved to a larger office in the medical building. We're on the second floor now.

SCRIPT W-Br Riccardo, the actor we were interested in for our film's leading role just called. She received another offer, so she doesn't think she'll be taking the part. M-Au Her audition was fantastic. l wouldn't want to replace her. What's the number of her agent? Maybe I can offer her more money for the role. W-Br I can get that number for you. By the way, don't forget to look over the hotel options that have been selected for our filming dates. The assistant needs to finalize those arrangements today.

SCRIPT M-Au Hello, I'm John Miller, the director of the city's Environmental Department. May I speak with Barbara Anderson from Horizons Landscape Architecture firm? W-Br Speaking! How can I help you? M-Au I'm pleased to inform you that your firm is being given the annual environmental sustainability award. W-Br I'm so glad to hear that! ln all our projects we're careful to use only native plants that don't require much watering. M-Au And that's been effective in helping conserve water throughout the region.

SCRIPT W-Br Pierre, I checked the weather report, and there's going to be continuous heavy rain throughout the week. M-Cn Oh, no—that'll cause problems for the employee picnic. We rented a tent as light shelter from the afternoon sun, but now it sounds like everything's going to be drenched. W-Br Well, we could move the event indoors. M-Cn True. And that wouldn't affect any of our team-building games we planned for the staff. W-Br Exactly. OK, so I guess booking the largest conference room is my next step.

SCRIPT W-Br So Felipe, it's been about three weeks since you injured your ankle playing basketball. How's it feeling? M-Cn Hi, Dr. Smith. It feels great! My coach and I are wondering if I'll be able to play in the championship game in two weeks? What's your professional opinion? Do you think my ankle will be healed by then? W-Br Hmm—Things look like they're healing, but you'll need to be evaluated again before game time. Could you come back some time next week?

SCRIPT M-Au Hello, my name's Alonso Fontana. l'd like to order a chocolate cake with strawberry sauce for an office party next Tuesday. My manager is turning 40 years old! W-Br OK. Will you need candles too? M-Au No, we already have those. W-Br That'll be twenty dollars. For an extra five dollars, we can deliver the cake. Would you be interested in that? M-Au Well, our budget is limited. W-Br I understand. OK, we'll have it ready on Tuesday morning. M-Au Oh, also, l have a colleague who is allergic to nuts. That won't be a problem, will it? W-Br No—we don't make any desserts with nut products in them.

SCRIPT M-Au Noriko, we just received a call from the Croyden Company. W-Am Great. We've been trying to get their business. Did they place an order? M-Au Yes, a rush request. They want three thousand full-color brochures and booklets printed by Friday. W-Am Four of our people are on vacation. M-Au We really need to do this. What about increasing the rate we pay for overtime, just for this job? That would motivate staff to work some extra hours.

SCRIPT M-Au So, we started this initiative with the aim of increasing energy efficiency in the office. Jerome, you're leading the project. How's it going? M-Cn We're making progress. More efficient lighting has been installed throughout the building. And we've significantly reduced paper usage, so we're running the printers less often. W-Br Yes, everyone seems motivated by the monthly challenge, especially after the accounting department won gift certificates last month. M-Au lt's great that employees are responding positively to the contest. M-Cn Now that we've tackled some easier changes, for the next phase I think we should consider overhauling the building's heating system. W-Br Good idea. I'm going to hire a contractor to help with that. I'll get some bids from different companies.

SCRIPT M-Cn Thanks to both of you for coming out this morning. I’ve purchased the land on the other side of the river to expand my vegetable crops, and I'd like to build a bridge to drive my tractor across the water. W-Am That's definitely the type of building project we do. We'll start today by measuring the span of the river and the height and slope of the riverbank. Right, Adriana? W-Br Right. Now, do you have a specific location in mind? If not, we can make that decision ourselves. That area by the oak tree looks nice and flat. Let's walk over there.

SCRIPT M-Cn Hi. l wanted to check the status of my flight—I'm supposed to be in Chicago to deliver a lecture tonight. W-Br Could I please see your boarding pass? M-Cn Sure, it's right here. W-Br Thank you. Unfortunately your flight is delayed by an hour due to a late connecting flight. M-Cn OK, that's fine. I was just worried it might be canceled. W-Br To make up for the delay, the airline's offering all passengers on the flight a free meal voucher for any restaurant in the food court. M-Cn 0h, that's a nice surprise!

SCRIPT W-Br Mark, as you know, sales of our pet food aren't as good as we'd hoped. I want to change our advertising strategy. Do you have a breakdown of advertising costs for different types of media? M-Au Sure. This graph shows how many dollars we'll have to spend to reach 1,000 people. W-Br Social media seems like the obvious choice, but that's how we've been advertising. We can cheaply advertise to a lot of people that way, but they aren’t buying. M-Au Exactly. l think we're better off spending sixteen dollars per thousand people. It's pricier, but research shows that those people are more likely to buy the product. W-Br OK. Please ask Paul to start drafting a new ad.

SCRIPT W-Am lt's great how much tourism has increased in our city this year. So many visitors to the area are coming in to ask us about things to do here! M-Au Absolutely. Ever since that cooking show premiered on television last year, tourists are asking us where to find local restaurants featured on the show. The food map we're making of the downtown area will be really popular. W-Am Yes, and it's almost ready to go to the printer. But—I noticed an error. The place at the corner of Second and Fielding Streets has moved to a bigger location north of the city. M-Au Oh, too bad. OK, I'll take it off.

SCRIPT W-Am Welcome, everyone, to Watanabe Nature Park. I'm happy you all joined us for our morning hiking tour. l recommend stopping at the top of the mountain for bird-watching. We may even be able to see some hawks or eagles flying overhead. You can return to the Visitor Center at your own pace, but please be back by twelve noon so we can all have lunch together at the picnic tables.

SCRIPT M-Cn Hi, Ms. Wang. lt's Richard, your real estate agent. I'm supposed to take pictures of your house today for your online listing, but I can't get in. I know we usually keep the key in a special place by the front door, but we did have a cleaning crew come yesterday. I have the number of the company, so I'll call them after this. While I wait to gain access to the house, l'll start taking photos of the exterior. I'll send them to you. Please decide which ones you want to use for your listing.

SCRIPT W-Am OK, everyone. As you know, the music festival is starting in two hours, and we still have a lot to do before then. The food vendors should be arriving soon. I'll have Maria direct them to their proper locations. I'm going to help the musicians with their equipment and sound tests. ln case of rain, remember, our plan is to hold the event indoors, in the building over there. But, really, we haven't had a day this nice in a while.

SCRIPT M-Au On behalf of Travers International, I'd like to thank the news reporters who've joined me this afternoon, as I announce our latest global initiative. Travers is conscious of the impact our ships and tankers have on the environment. As a leader in the ocean shipping industry, we're promising to reduce our waste emissions by twenty percent in the next five years. This will significantly decrease the amount of carbon released into the oceans. I'm very proud of this initiative. I believe it will impact the environment in a positive way.

SCRIPT W-Am Good afternoon. I'm calling from Blue Tern Press to ask if you'd be willing to write an introduction for a new edition of the eighteenth¬ century novel Hillsbrook Hall. As you know, another version of the manuscript—handwritten and edited by the author —was recently discovered. We'd like to print a new edition of Hillsbrook Hall based on the newly discovered manuscript. As an expert in eighteenth-century literature, we'd like you to write the introduction. If you're interested, call me back as soon as possible to talk about a contract for this project.

SCRIPT M-Au Good afternoon, everyone. I've recently announced I'm stepping down as board secretary for Winfield Paper Company, and as you know, Ji-Min Choi will be taking over my role. To make the transition easier, I'm making a list of what the secretary role entails. This will also allow me to document the changes that we've wanted to make to this role. For example, remember in October the board discussed storing meeting minutes in a secure, online location? I'm including that information. After I leave. I'll be available to assist Ji-Min with any questions that may come up.

SCRIPT M-Cn Hello! If you're watching this online video, then you've recently purchased Karoo, a state-of-the-art software program that manages different collections of data. Karoo increases the efficiency of how companies share information— both internally with staff and externally with clients. In this video, I'll walk you through the steps to setting up the program. Before getting started, I suggest reopening this video on a device other than the one where you're installing the program. That way, you can use the chat function on this Web site to contact a live agent if you need to.

SCRIPT M-Au I think going into the new year, we should focus more of our budget on late-night programming. Local news ends at eleven o'clock, and we could follow that with a 90-minute talk show. Viewers these days are staying up much later in search of something funny to watch. We just need a great host, and advertisers will be fighting for this time slot. It's usually a real challenge to find new talent, but a comedy club just opened up in the arts district. Now, changing topics, I'd like to share some good news. A few of you have been chosen to receive the director's award for outstanding leadership. Please stand when I call your names.

SCRIPT W-Am Do you like trying new things? Then Samantha's new snack delivery service is for you. Each month, our team assembles a variety of snacks from different parts of the world and delivers them to your door. Best of all, starting in January, we're packaging our snacks in cooled containers. This refrigerated shipping allows us to offer a bigger selection of foods. Just go to the Web site and choose how many months you'd like to sign up for. Right now, we're offering a special promotion. To qualify, just subscribe for at least three months, and you'll receive an extra box for free!

SCRIPT M-Au Thanks for joining this online workshop on making candles. Today, we'll focus on scented candles. As always, please write questions in the chat box, and we'll answer them as we go. Good news—we've just enabled automatic captioning, so if you'd like to use this new feature, please click the ''Captions'' button on the screen. Finally, if you'd like to see more content like this, please consider subscribing to our Web site for five dollars a month. We release exclusive video content each week for our subscribers. Let's get started with the first step—choosing a color.

Subject: Research results

Ms. Kucharski,

The following is a summary of what I have learned in my research about where to hold our next annual technology conference in June of next year.

In Rome, the best option I have found is Hotel al Ponte. The total cost for conference events there would be €31,500. — [1] — Individual hotel rooms would cost €80 per night for participants. In the event that attendance is high, we could also house participants in the nearby Hotel Milvio at €120 per night. — [2] —.

I also looked into hotels in Genoa and Florence, but I could not find any that would be much cheaper in overall conference costs. — [3] —. More importantly, I am concerned that the greater cost of flights to those smaller cities could discourage some attendees. Rome, on the other hand, has affordable direct flights from most European cities. — [4] —. It will also be more affordable for our colleagues coming from Buenos Aires.

If you would like to pursue the Hotel al Ponte option, I will provide a detailed write-up of the anticipated costs and of the amenities offered by the hotel.

Best,

Luciano Moretti

Secretary, International Technological Society

- Paraphrase: decide which ones you want to use (quyết định xem bạn muốn dùng những cái nào) = Choose some photos (Chọn một số bức ảnh).

questions.stem: What are the listeners preparing for?
questions.explanation:
77. - Dẫn chứng: "the music festival is starting in two hours, and we still have a lot to do before then" (lễ hội âm nhạc sẽ bắt đầu sau hai giờ nữa, và chúng ta vẫn còn rất nhiều việc phải làm trước đó).
- Paraphrase: music festival (lễ hội âm nhạc) = A music festival (Một lễ hội âm nhạc).

questions.stem: What will Maria be responsible for?

options.text: Showing vendors where they need to be

questions.explanation:
78. - Dẫn chứng: "The food vendors have a lot to do before then. I'll have Maria direct them to their proper locations" (Các bên bán đồ ăn có rất nhiều việc phải làm trước đó. Tôi sẽ bảo Maria hướng dẫn họ đến đúng vị trí của mình).
- Paraphrase: direct them to their proper locations (hướng dẫn họ đến đúng vị trí) = Showing vendors where they need to be (Chỉ cho những người bán hàng nơi họ cần ở đó).

questions.stem: What does the speaker mean when she says, “we haven’t had a day this nice in a while”?

options.text: Some tests may not be necessary.
She is excited about an outing with friends.
An event will probably not need to be moved.
The weather has been unusually cold recently.

questions.explanation:
79. - Dẫn chứng: "In case of rain, remember, our plan is to hold the event indoors, in the building over there." (Trong trường hợp trời mưa, hãy nhớ rằng kế hoạch của chúng ta là tổ chức sự kiện trong nhà, ở tòa nhà đằng kia).
- Paraphrase: hold the event indoors (tổ chức sự kiện trong nhà) = The weather has been unusually cold recently (Thời tiết gần đây lạnh bất thường - đây là câu gây nhiễu, dẫn chứng đúng tập trung vào phương án dự phòng thời tiết).

questions.stem: Where does the speech most likely take place?
questions.explanation:
80. - Dẫn chứng: "On behalf of Travers International, I’d like to thank the news reporters who’ve joined me this afternoon, as I announce our latest global initiative." (Thay mặt cho Travers International, tôi muốn cảm ơn các phóng viên tin tức đã tham gia cùng tôi chiều nay, khi tôi công bố sáng kiến toàn cầu mới nhất của chúng tôi).
- Paraphrase: news reporters who've joined me (các phóng viên tin tức đã tham gia cùng tôi) = At a press conference (Tại một cuộc họp báo).

questions.stem: What industry does the speaker work in?
questions.explanation:
81. - Dẫn chứng: "As a leader in the ocean shipping industry, we’re promising to reduce our waste emissions..." (Là một đơn vị dẫn đầu trong ngành vận tải đường biển, chúng tôi hứa sẽ giảm lượng khí thải chất thải...).
- Paraphrase: ocean shipping industry (ngành vận tải đường biển) = Shipping (Vận tải biển).

questions.stem: What does the speaker say he is proud of?
questions.explanation:
82. - Dẫn chứng: "I'm very proud of this initiative." (Tôi rất tự hào về sáng kiến này).
- Paraphrase: initiative (sáng kiến/kế hoạch mới) = An environmental initiative (Một sáng kiến về môi trường).

questions.stem: What industry does the speaker most likely work in?
questions.explanation:
83. - Dẫn chứng: "I'm calling from Blue Tern Press to ask if you'd be willing to write an introduction for a new edition of the eighteenth-century novel Hillsbrook Hall." (Tôi gọi từ nhà xuất bản Blue Tern Press để hỏi liệu ông có sẵn lòng viết lời giới thiệu cho ấn bản mới của cuốn tiểu thuyết thế kỷ 18 Hillsbrook Hall không).
- Paraphrase: Blue Tern Press (Tên nhà xuất bản) = Publishing (Xuất bản).

questions.stem: What does the speaker say recently happened?

options.text: A book was made into a film.

questions.explanation:
84. - Dẫn chứng: "Another version of the manuscript—handwritten and edited by the author—was recently discovered." (Một bản thảo khác của tác phẩm—được viết tay và chỉnh sửa bởi chính tác giả—vừa mới được tìm thấy).
- Paraphrase: manuscript was recently discovered (bản thảo vừa được tìm thấy) = A manuscript was found (Một bản thảo đã được tìm thấy).

questions.stem: Why does the speaker want the listener to call her back?
questions.explanation:
85. - Dẫn chứng: "If you’re interested, call me back as soon as possible to talk about a contract for this project." (Nếu ông quan tâm, hãy gọi lại cho tôi càng sớm càng tốt để thảo luận về hợp đồng cho dự án này).
- Paraphrase: talk about a contract (thảo luận về hợp đồng) = To discuss a contract (Để thảo luận về một hợp đồng).

questions.stem: What is the speaker currently working on?
questions.explanation:
86. - Dẫn chứng: "I’m making a list of what the secretary role entails." (Tôi đang lập một danh sách những gì mà vai trò thư ký đòi hỏi).
- Paraphrase: making a list of what the role entails (lập danh sách những việc vai trò đó yêu cầu) = Listing some job duties (Liệt kê một số nhiệm vụ công việc).

questions.stem: What did the board talk about in October?
questions.explanation:
87. - Dẫn chứng: "...remember in October the board discussed storing meeting minutes in a secure, online location?" (...còn nhớ vào tháng Mười ban quản trị đã thảo luận về việc lưu trữ biên bản cuộc họp ở một địa điểm trực tuyến an toàn không?).
- Paraphrase: storing meeting minutes in a secure, online location (lưu trữ biên bản họp tại một nơi trực tuyến an toàn) = Keeping some documents online (Lưu giữ một số tài liệu trực tuyến).

questions.stem: What will the speaker be available to do?
questions.explanation:
88. - Dẫn chứng: "After I leave, I'll be available to assist Ji-Min with any questions that may come up." (Sau khi tôi rời đi, tôi sẽ sẵn lòng hỗ trợ Ji-Min với bất kỳ câu hỏi nào có thể phát sinh).
- Paraphrase: assist Ji-Min (hỗ trợ Ji-Min) = Assist a colleague (Hỗ trợ một đồng nghiệp).

questions.stem: What did the listener buy?
questions.explanation:
89. - Dẫn chứng: "You’ve recently purchased Karoo, a state-of-the-art software program that manages different collections of data." (Gần đây bạn đã mua Karoo, một chương trình phần mềm hiện đại giúp quản lý các tập hợp dữ liệu khác nhau).
- Paraphrase: software program (chương trình phần mềm) = A software program (Một chương trình phần mềm).

questions.stem: According to the speaker, how will the product improve a business?

options.text: It will make sharing information easier.
It will help attract more clients.

questions.explanation:
90. - Dẫn chứng: "Karoo increases the efficiency of how companies share information—both internally with staff and externally with clients." (Karoo làm tăng hiệu quả của việc các công ty chia sẻ thông tin—cả nội bộ với nhân viên và bên ngoài với khách hàng).
- Paraphrase: increases the efficiency of how companies share information (tăng hiệu quả chia sẻ thông tin của công ty) = It will make sharing information easier (Nó sẽ giúp việc chia sẻ thông tin dễ dàng hơn).

questions.stem: What does the speaker recommend?
questions.explanation:
91. - Dẫn chứng: "Before getting started, I suggest reopening this video on a device other than the one where you’re installing the program." (Trước khi bắt đầu, tôi đề nghị mở lại video này trên một thiết bị khác với thiết bị mà bạn đang cài đặt chương trình).
- Paraphrase: reopening this video on a device other than the one (mở lại video này trên một thiết bị khác) = Using a second device (Sử dụng một thiết bị thứ hai).

questions.stem: Where does the speaker most likely work?
questions.explanation:
92. - Dẫn chứng: "Local news ends at eleven o’clock, and we could follow that with a 90-minute talk show." (Tin tức địa phương kết thúc lúc 11 giờ, và chúng ta có thể tiếp nối chương trình đó bằng một buổi trò chuyện dài 90 phút).
- Paraphrase: Local news ends at eleven o'clock (Tin tức địa phương kết thúc lúc 11 giờ) = At a television station (Tại một đài truyền hình).

questions.stem: Why does the speaker say, “a comedy club just opened up in the arts district”?

options.text: To express surprise about a timeline
To suggest a solution to a problem

questions.explanation:
93. - Dẫn chứng: "It’s usually a real challenge to find new talent, but a comedy club just opened up in the arts district." (Thường thì rất khó khăn để tìm kiếm tài năng mới, nhưng một câu lạc bộ hài vừa mới khai trương ở khu nghệ thuật).
- Paraphrase: find new talent (tìm kiếm tài năng mới) = To suggest a solution to a problem (Để đề xuất giải pháp cho một vấn đề).

questions.stem: What will the speaker do next?
questions.explanation:
94. - Dẫn chứng: "Please stand when I call your names." (Vui lòng đứng dậy khi tôi gọi tên các bạn).
- Paraphrase: call your names (gọi tên các bạn) = Announce award winners (Công bố những người thắng giải).

questions.stem: What is being advertised for monthly delivery?
questions.explanation:
95. - Dẫn chứng: "Each month, our team assembles a variety of snacks from different parts of the world and delivers them to your door." (Mỗi tháng, đội ngũ của chúng tôi tập hợp nhiều loại đồ ăn nhẹ từ các nơi khác nhau trên thế giới và giao chúng đến tận cửa nhà bạn).
- Paraphrase: snacks from different parts of the world (đồ ăn nhẹ từ các nơi khác nhau trên thế giới) = International snacks (Đồ ăn nhẹ quốc tế).

questions.stem: What does the speaker say will be available in January?
questions.explanation:
96. - Dẫn chứng: "starting in January, we’re packaging our snacks in cooled containers" (bắt đầu từ tháng Giêng, chúng tôi sẽ đóng gói đồ ăn nhẹ của mình trong các thùng chứa làm mát).
- Paraphrase: packaging our snacks in cooled containers (đóng gói đồ ăn nhẹ trong thùng làm mát) = Refrigerated shipping (Vận chuyển đông lạnh).

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. What is the smallest subscription amount needed to receive an extra box?
questions.explanation:
97. - Dẫn chứng: "Just subscribe for at least three months, and you'll receive an extra box for free!" (Chỉ cần đăng ký ít nhất ba tháng, và bạn sẽ nhận được một hộp bổ sung miễn phí!).
- Đối chiếu đồ họa: Gói 3 tháng (3 months) có giá 25.00 USD là gói nhỏ nhất thỏa mãn điều kiện "ít nhất 3 tháng".
- Paraphrase: subscribe for at least three months (đăng ký ít nhất 3 tháng) = $25.00.

questions.stem: What is the topic of the workshop?
questions.explanation:
98. - Dẫn chứng: "Thanks for joining this online workshop on making candles." (Cảm ơn các bạn đã tham gia buổi thảo luận trực tuyến về việc làm nến).
- Paraphrase: making candles (làm nến) = Making candles (Làm nến).

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. Which button represents a new feature of the software program?
questions.explanation:
99. - Dẫn chứng: "...we’ve-just-enabled automatic captioning, so if you’d like to use this new feature, please click the “Captions” button on the screen." (...chúng tôi vừa kích hoạt tính năng phụ đề tự động, vì vậy nếu bạn muốn sử dụng tính năng mới này, vui lòng nhấp vào nút "Captions" trên màn hình).
- Đối chiếu đồ họa: Trên màn hình máy tính, nút số 2 được dán nhãn là Captions.
- Paraphrase: click the “Captions” button (nhấp vào nút Phụ đề) = Button 2 (Nút số 2).

questions.stem: What does the speaker say is a benefit of subscribing?
questions.explanation:
100. - Dẫn chứng: "If you’d like to see more content like this, please consider subscribing to our Web site for five dollars a month." (Nếu bạn muốn xem thêm nhiều nội dung như thế này, vui lòng cân nhắc đăng ký trang web của chúng tôi với giá năm đô la một tháng).
- Paraphrase: see more content like this (xem thêm nhiều nội dung như thế này) = Additional video content (Nội dung video bổ sung).

questions.stem: Aberdeen Bank offers a range of financial services ------- the needs of its customers.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc "To-V" được dùng để chỉ mục đích (để đáp ứng nhu cầu). "Meet the needs" là cụm từ cố định thường gặp.

questions.stem: ------- staff are asked to provide a backup cell phone number and e-mail address.
questions.explanation: "All" là từ định lượng duy nhất trong các lựa chọn đi kèm được với danh từ số nhiều "staff" (trong ngữ cảnh này là tập thể nhân viên).

questions.stem: Today, Mr. Rahn will present ------- ideas to improve the company’s accounting software.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng trước danh từ "ideas" nên cần một tính từ sở hữu. "His" là lựa chọn phù hợp nhất để chỉ ý tưởng của ông Rahn.

questions.stem: The firm's one-hour lunch policy is ------- enforced, so do not return late.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "strictly" (một cách nghiêm ngặt) thường đi kèm với động từ "enforce" (thực thi) để nói về nội quy.

questions.stem: Ms. Martinova’s promotion to chief financial officer is contingent ------- approval by our board of executives.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc "contingent on/upon" là một cụm từ cố định có nghĩa là "tùy thuộc vào" hoặc "còn tùy vào".

questions.stem: The peninsula’s southernmost portion is rarely visited because it is not ------- accessible to travelers.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống bổ nghĩa cho tính từ "accessible", nên cần một trạng từ. "Easily accessible" (dễ dàng tiếp cận) là cụm từ rất phổ biến.

questions.stem: The Vaknis Group ------- all clients a flat consultation fee, to be paid in advance.
questions.explanation: Động từ "charges" (tính phí) phù hợp nhất với tân ngữ là "a flat consultation fee" (một mức phí tư vấn cố định).

questions.stem: On August 19, employees will not be able to access their e-mail account ------- time sheet.
questions.explanation: Liên từ "or" (hoặc) dùng để liệt kê hai đối tượng bị giới hạn truy cập là "e-mail account" hoặc "time sheet".

questions.stem: Walk-in clients are ------- a reliable source of business for the Auburn Hair Salon.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "typically" (thông thường/điển hình) dùng để mô tả một thực tế thường xuyên xảy ra đối với salon tóc này.

questions.stem: By the end of the year, all packaging used for Schaefer’s food products will be ------- recyclable.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "fully" (hoàn toàn) bổ nghĩa cho tính từ "recyclable" (có thể tái chế) để chỉ mức độ của bao bì.

questions.stem: Highbrook Hotel staff are trained to provide each guest with an exceptional -------.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng sau tính từ "exceptional", cần một danh từ. "Exceptional experience" (trải nghiệm đặc biệt/tuyệt vời) là cụm danh từ phù hợp.

questions.stem: In ------- for their help, volunteers at the library's book sale were given personalized tea mugs.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc "In appreciation for" (để tri ân/ghi nhận cho) là một cụm từ cố định trong thư cảm ơn hoặc thông báo.

questions.stem: Because employees must learn to use the new software, several training sessions will take place ------- the next two weeks.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "over" được dùng để chỉ một khoảng thời gian kéo dài (trong suốt 2 tuần tới).

questions.stem: Flight attendants asked passengers to take their seats ------- upon boarding the plane.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "quickly" (nhanh chóng) bổ nghĩa cho động từ "take their seats" để chỉ hành động cần thực hiện ngay khi lên máy bay.

questions.stem: Last July, Rojas Rieper LLC ------- a grand opening celebration.
questions.explanation: Trạng ngữ "Last July" (Tháng 7 năm ngoái) cho thấy hành động đã xảy ra, nên động từ phải chia ở thì Quá khứ đơn "hosted".

questions.stem: Mr. Kim was one ------- three people who received the firm’s Competitive Edge award.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc "one of + danh từ số nhiều" (một trong những...). Ở đây "three people" là đối tượng được chọn ra.

questions.stem: Interviews begin today for the production manager ------- at Zhu Pharmaceuticals.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng sau danh từ "manager", cần một danh từ để tạo thành cụm "manager position" (vị trí quản lý).

questions.stem: Tours of the historic courthouse are offered twice a week ------- the summer.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "during" (trong suốt) dùng để chỉ một khoảng thời gian (mùa hè) mà các chuyến tham quan được cung cấp.

questions.stem: ------- the next few months, Abundi Ltd. will open its fourth pharmaceutical laboratory in New Zealand.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "Within" (trong vòng) dùng để chỉ một khoảng thời gian mà trong đó sự việc sẽ xảy ra (trong vòng vài tháng tới).

questions.stem: The ------- at Yohanan Company organizes the delivery of supplies to all conference locations.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng sau mạo từ "The" và làm chủ ngữ, nên cần một danh từ chỉ người "coordinator" (người điều phối).

questions.stem: The owners of Rowecroft Porcelain ------- to begin production of casual dinnerware sets next month.
questions.explanation: Sau chủ ngữ "The owners", câu đang thiếu động từ chính. "Intend to" (có ý định làm gì) là cấu trúc phù hợp.

questions.stem: Mykos Auto Makers agreed to grant long¬term factory employees ------- vacation time.
questions.explanation: Tính từ "extended" (kéo dài/thêm) bổ nghĩa cho "vacation time" để chỉ việc tăng thêm thời gian nghỉ phép cho nhân viên lâu năm.

questions.stem: The customer -------believed that the coat he had purchased was waterproof.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "mistakenly" (một cách sai lầm) bổ nghĩa cho động từ "believed" để chỉ việc hiểu lầm về tính năng của chiếc áo.

questions.stem: All cars built by Roadway Motors come ------- with an alarm reminding drivers to buckle their seat belts.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc "come equipped with" có nghĩa là "được trang bị sẵn với". "Equipped" là phân từ đóng vai trò tính từ.

questions.stem: The components of the CT640 dishwasher are largely the same as ------- of earlier models.
questions.explanation: "Those" là đại từ thay thế cho danh từ số nhiều "The components" để tránh lặp từ trong phép so sánh.

questions.stem: The Nakato Group has won several industry awards for its innovative marketing -------.
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ "marketing strategies" (các chiến lược tiếp thị).

questions.stem: Krit Pinthong’s new mystery novel is the most widely ------- book of the year.
questions.explanation: "Anticipated" (được mong đợi) là tính từ phù hợp nhất để mô tả một cuốn tiểu thuyết mới đang được dư luận chờ đón.

questions.stem: The leadership team was quite relieved ------- the Tovyar building project was completed under budget.
questions.explanation: Liên từ "when" (khi) dùng để chỉ thời điểm mà đội ngũ lãnh đạo cảm thấy nhẹ nhõm (khi dự án hoàn thành).

questions.stem: ------- two floors of offices, the building offers several retail spaces.
questions.explanation: Cụm "In addition to" (ngoài... ra/thêm vào đó) dùng để liệt kê thêm các không gian bán lẻ bên cạnh các tầng văn phòng.

questions.stem: ------- regarding construction noise and traffic delays should be directed to Mr. Jasdi, the project manager.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống làm chủ ngữ, cần một danh từ số nhiều phù hợp với động từ "should be directed". "Concerns" (mối quan tâm/lo ngại) là hợp lý nhất.

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following advertisement.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "now" (hiện tại/ngay bây giờ) được dùng để chỉ một hành động đang diễn ra hoặc một trạng thái hiện thời. Trong quảng cáo tuyển dụng, nó nhấn mạnh việc công ty đang cần người ngay lập tức.
